instructions.title: Payment Instructions
instructions.va.mbanking_step2: Select the 'Transfer' menu, then choose 'Virtual Account' or 'E-Billing'.
instructions.va.mbanking_step3: Enter the Virtual Account number or Payment Code displayed above.
instructions.va.mbanking_step4: Enter the exact payment amount matching the Grand Total.
instructions.va.mbanking_step5: Enter your PIN and complete the transaction.
instructions.va.atm_step1: Insert your ATM card and enter your PIN.
instructions.va.atm_step2: Select 'Other Transactions' > 'Transfer' > 'Virtual Account' or 'To Bank Account'.
instructions.va.atm_step4: Ensure the payment amount and recipient name are correct.
instructions.va.atm_step5: Press Yes/Correct to execute the payment.
instructions.qris.step1: Open your e-wallet app (Gojek, Shopee, OVO, Dana, LinkAja) or your Mobile Banking application.
instructions.qris.step3: Point your camera at the QR Code displayed on your screen.
instructions.qris.step4: Confirm the payment details in the application and enter your PIN.
instructions.qris.step5: Wait for the transaction to be automatically confirmed.
instructions.ovo.step1: Open the OVO application on your phone.
instructions.ovo.step2: Check your notification history or the push notification that appears.
instructions.ovo.step3: Approve the transaction and enter your OVO PIN.
instructions.wallet.step1: Open the application link on your phone or scan the generated QR code.
instructions.wallet.step2: Your digital wallet application will open automatically.
instructions.wallet.step3: Verify the billing amount and ensure you have sufficient balance.
instructions.wallet.step4: Authenticate the payment using your PIN or Digital Wallet authentication method.
instructions.retail.step2: Inform the cashier that you wish to make a payment for Midtrans/Fayyfir Shop merchant.
instructions.retail.step3: Show the Payment Code displayed above to the cashier.
instructions.retail.step4: Make a cash/debit payment equal to the transaction Grand Total.
instructions.retail.step5: Keep the payment receipt as proof of transaction.
